name: Modal confirmation alignment
instruction: Align the confirmation button to the right edge inside the dialog.

name: Dashboard card spacing
instruction: Reduce the gaps between dashboard cards to 20 pixels.

name: Sidebar overlap
instruction: Ensure the main content starts to the right of the fixed sidebar with at least 24 pixels of spacing.

name: Dropdown interaction
instruction: Keep the project filter open when clicking or typing inside its search field. Clicking outside should close it.

name: Mobile navigation overflow
instruction: Keep navigation within a 390 pixel viewport without horizontal page scrolling. Wrap links if needed.

name: Active tab appearance
instruction: Make the active tab visually distinct from inactive tabs, including after switching tabs.

name: Keyboard focus
instruction: Show a visible focus indicator when the Create project button is reached with the keyboard.

name: Validation feedback
instruction: Display the validation error after submitting an invalid email; hide it after a valid email.

name: Dialog scrolling
instruction: Allow scrolling inside the constrained Terms preview dialog to reach and click Accept.

name: Counter state update
instruction: Update the visible member count every time Add member is clicked.
